entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 07.11.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Mahuda (Bhatdih) P.S. Case No.87 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 366 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It appears that the applicant is accused of committing rape.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
5.
Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
Further, it has been submitted that as per the allegation the girl has been kidnapped on 05.09.2022 and she returned her house on 18.10.2022 and the FIR has been lodged on 06.11.2022.

On the above basis, prayer for bail has been Ranjit Bhuiya @ Nanku Bhuiya vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168312628/
1 made.
6.

entities.text: Ranjit Bhuiya @ Nanku Bhuiya vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the above facts, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Dhanbad in connection with Mahuda (Bhatdih) P.S. Case No.87 of 2022, subject to condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
